connectors.description: List of AppConnectors that are authorised to be associated with this AppConnection
connectors.rationale: This attribute associates the AppConnectors to the AppConnection and does not directly impact security.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description: An arbitrary user-provided name for the AppConnection.
display_name.rationale: Display name is for user convenience and does not impact security.

labels.description:
Resource labels to represent user provided metadata.


**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for metadata and do not directly impact security.

name.rationale: This name is not related to security related policies.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is used to identify the project resource. Some organisations may have policies that restrict which projects can be used, but this is not inherently a security issue.

region.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

type.description:
The type of network connectivity used by the AppConnection. Refer
to https://cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.appConnections#type
for a list of possible values.
type.rationale: Only TCP_PROXY is allowed as the AppConnection type for compliance.

application_endpoint.description: Address of the remote application endpoint for the BeyondCorp AppConnection.

application_endpoint.host.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote application endpoint.
application_endpoint.host.rationale: Hostname or IP of the remote application endpoint the connection targets. This is a reference/pointer to another endpoint; we do not constrain what a resource points at and a generic policy cannot pin a team-specific host.

application_endpoint.port.description: Port of the remote application endpoint.
application_endpoint.port.rationale: The port of the remote application endpoint the connection targets. This is a connection detail pointing at another endpoint; a generic policy cannot prescribe a team-specific port, so it is not a policy target.

gateway.app_gateway.rationale: The AppGateway name is used to identify the gateway resource.

gateway.type.description:
The type of hosting used by the gateway. Refer to
https://cloud.google.com/beyondcorp/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.appConnections#Type_1
for a list of possible values.
gateway.type.rationale: The type of hosting does not inherently affect security policies.
